messages:
maya: hey team :wave: accepted the org invite but I can't access private repos or re-run Actions jobs (403).
sam: @maya can you screenshot the Actions error or paste the banner text?
maya: shows `403 Forbidden` and a small box saying 'You must enable SSO and 2FA to access organization resources.'
it-bot: FYI: Redwood Inference requires org SSO + 2FA. See https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso
maya: i thought i already had 2FA on my account. i accepted with maya.personal@gmail.com — oops.
jen: that will block SSO mapping. did you have your work email added to that GitHub account?
maya: no. i opened the PR from that personal account too.
sam: two ways:
- add your work email to the personal account and verify + enable 2FA, then we can map it to SSO (PR stays intact);
- accept invite with your work account and we can try to transfer the PR but author attribution may change.
maya: prefer to keep the PR as-is.
platform-eng: we can do the mapping sync. preferred flow:
1) add maya@redwood.ai under Settings → Emails on github.com and verify
2) enable TOTP 2FA (or hardware key)
3) visit the org invite link and accept SSO
I'll trigger a manual org sync after you confirm.
maya: added and verified maya@redwood.ai, enabled TOTP. clicking invite still shows 'Team membership pending'.
platform-eng: thanks — i ran a manual SSO mapping sync and pushed you into teams: eng, devex. Also temporarily granted repo:infra write so you can re-run CI.
sam: try reloading Actions and re-run the failing job.
maya: just re-ran it and it accepted! can see private repos now :tada:
jen: welcome aboard officially — drop a short intro in #new-hires-intros when you have a mo :smile:
maya: will do, and i'll coordinate with @sam about moving the PR to my work account later if we want to consolidate. huge thanks everyone for the fast help :)
